description.value: A historic pub on the South Island Highway celebrated for its locally harvested Fanny Bay oysters and lively community atmosphere. The summer beer garden offers coastal views and a dog-friendly patio where minors are also welcome. Regular live music nights, Saturday jam sessions, and karaoke evenings make it a notable social hub for travellers passing through the Comox Valley corridor.
